title: Equal steps under transition agreement
statement: Let $M$ and $N$ be Turing machines with the same number of work tapes, symbol alphabet, and state set, and let $Q$ be a set of states. Suppose their transition actions agree for every state in $Q$ and every possible scanned input and work-tape symbols. For any input and configuration $c$ whose state, whenever present, belongs to $Q$, one step of $N$ from $c$ equals one step of $M$ from $c$.
